findings.source_en: Well, no sense in lettin’ it go to waste.
findings.ar: وعلى أي حال، من العبث أن ندعه يضيع، وقد مات أخوه في الحرب.
findings.issue: The Arabic appends an invented clause وقد مات أخوه في الحرب (“and his brother died in the war”) that has no counterpart anywhere in the English line.
findings.suggested_ar: وعلى أي حال، من العبث أن ندعه يضيع.

findings.source_en: There’s not really much to tell.
findings.issue: The negation is dropped: the Arabic asserts “there is much to tell”, the exact opposite of Merrick deflecting Proxima’s question about his people’s funerals.

findings.source_en: Every brigand within fifty miles has probably been here.
findings.ar: لا يمكنك الجزم بذلك؛ فلم ينتهِ البحث بعد.
findings.issue: This row carries the Arabic belonging to the sibling key 90E99614… (“You cannot know that. There is more to search.”) — the two rows’ Arabic are swapped.
findings.suggested_ar: الأرجح أن كل لصٍّ في نطاق خمسين ميلًا مرّ من هنا.

findings.source_en: Hm. You may prove useful after all.
findings.ar: همم. قد تكونين مفيدة في النهاية.
findings.issue: Addressee is wrong: this is Proxima appraising Merrick after he offers to find her weapon, so it must be masculine — the feminine تكونين مفيدة points the line back at Proxima herself.
findings.suggested_ar: همم. قد تكون مفيدًا في النهاية.

findings.issue: Merrick addresses Proxima (female) but the pronoun is explicitly vowelled masculine أنتَ while the demonstrative ذي is feminine — internally contradictory and wrong for the addressee.

The Brigand King is scoffing at Proxima’s claim “My weapon. You have it.”, and he addresses her with feminine forms elsewhere in the same scene (أتقصدين، حاولي، تفضّلي); the explicitly masculine سلاحكَ contradicts that.

Glossary freezes Hexapod as السداسيّ الأرجل, but this row and its sibling EC396378… (“What did the, uh, Hexapod do to you?”) transliterate it as الهكسابود; note the transliteration may be deliberate, since Merrick’s “hexa-dog” mishearing in row 38A7630B… only works on a transliterated stem.
findings.suggested_ar: السداسيّ الأرجل. (أو أقرّ النقل الصوتي رسميًا في المسرد لأجل التورية)
